description: This file contains the implementation of the ClusterHealthMonitor class, which is responsible for monitoring the health of silos within an Orleans cluster. It manages the lifecycle of silo health monitors, processes membership updates, evicts stale silos, and performs health checks.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class responsible for monitoring the health of silos in an Orleans cluster, including managing silo health monitors, processing membership updates, and performing health checks.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitor.ITestAccessor
classes.description: An internal interface exposing private members of ClusterHealthMonitor for testing purposes.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership table updates, updating monitored silos, evicting stale silos, and handling shutdown.

methods.name: EvictStaleStateSilos
methods.description: Evicts silos that have exceeded the maximum join attempt time or are suspected to be stale.

methods.name: UpdateMonitoredSilos
methods.description: Determines which silos should be monitored based on membership state, using hash rings for probabilistic monitoring, and manages the creation of silo health monitors.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the ClusterHealthMonitor to lifecycle events for starting and stopping monitoring activities.

methods.name: OnProbeResultInternal
methods.description: Handles the result of a health probe, suspecting or killing silos based on probe outcomes.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check on monitored silos, aggregating their health statuses.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the monitor synchronously, cancelling ongoing operations and disposing silo health monitors.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the monitor, cancelling operations and disposing silo health monitors.
